lede: Western Michigan carries the stronger underlying team rating — -1.6 against -2.5, a 0.9-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Western Michigan -2.0 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Western Michigan winning 55% of simulations.

Data confidence on this matchup is 84% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
